name: CI (Linux System Libs)

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Qt Libraries
      uses: tlambert03/setup-qt-libs@19e4ef2d781d81f5f067182e228b54ec90d23b76

    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: namespacelabs/nscloud-cache-action@v1
      with:
        spacectl-version: "latest"
        spacectl-system-binary: "linux"
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        fail-on-cache-miss: true
        detect: true
        cache: "ccextractor-dependencies"
        path: "./"

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libswscale-dev

    - name: Build basic variant
      run: ./configure --enable-hardsubx && make -j$(nproc) && strip ccextractor

    - name: Build hardsubx variant
      run: ./configure --enable-hardsubx && make -j$(nproc) && strip ccextractor_hardsubx

    - name: Run ldd check
      run: |
        echo "Basic variant:"
        ldd ccextractor
        echo "Hardsubx variant:"
        ldd ccextractor_hardsubx

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ccextractor-binaries
        path: |
          ccextractor
          ccextractor_hardsubx
